name: Spec proposal (HEP)

title: "HEP-NNNN: <short title>"
labels: ["proposal", "hep", "needs-triage"]

<!--
This template is for substantive proposals to change protocol behavior, schemas,
conformance requirements, or normative semantics. Editorial fixes and typo
corrections do not need a HEP — open a PR directly.

Substantive proposals follow the HEP process documented in CONTRIBUTING.md §3.
-->

## Summary

<!-- One paragraph. What is the change in plain English? -->

## Motivation

<!-- The concrete problem this solves. Bullet points are fine. Real examples
     from production deployments are highly persuasive. -->

## Detailed design

<!-- The actual proposed change. Include:
     - Schema diffs (before / after)
     - Example messages showing the new behavior
     - Wire-flow diagrams for any new interaction patterns
     - New error codes (if any)
     - Conformance level affected (Core / Extended / Sovereign)
-->

## Alternatives considered

<!-- What other designs did you weigh? Why this one? Saying "none" is rarely
     the right answer for a substantive proposal. -->

## Backwards compatibility

<!-- Does this break existing implementations?
     - Wire-level break? (requires minor version bump)
     - Behavioral change that doesn't change the wire? (still requires care)
     - Purely additive? (can ship in a patch if non-breaking)
-->

## Security implications

<!-- Required section. Even if you believe there are none, write that and
     justify it. Security-relevant changes also require review by a maintainer
     with the security-reviewer label. -->

## Privacy implications

<!-- Required section. What new information is exposed in messages? What
     receipt content changes? GDPR/CCPA implications? -->

## Performance implications

<!-- Hot-path impact estimate. Is anything more expensive to verify? -->

## Migration plan

<!-- For breaking changes:
     - When does the old behavior get deprecated?
     - When does it get removed?
     - What does the migration guide need to say?
     - How should test vectors evolve?
-->

## Open questions

<!-- Things you want feedback on. -->
